objective: Create the platform repository skeleton described by the P0.2 design of the guide repository: one workspace, the layout every later package lands in, the module registry, the seven dependency rules generated from it, the migration lint, a boundary test suite that proves both fire, the charter, the continuity records and their schemas, and the CI skeleton.
completed_scope: One pnpm workspace with the top-level layout the P0.2 design draws
modules/modules.yaml registering all 30 candidate modules of the ARCH-001 capability map, grouped platform, brokerage, financial and integration, plus platform-configuration from the P0.12 design
Four module packages, tenancy, identity-access, audit and platform-configuration, each with a public contract and a private internal half; every exported function throws
packages/contracts and packages/observability, which import no module
scripts/registry.mjs, a strict dependency-free reader that refuses a malformed registry with a line number
scripts/boundary-rules.mjs and scripts/generate-boundary-rules.mjs, which generate .dependency-cruiser.cjs and tsconfig.paths.json from the registry, with a --check mode that fails on a hand edit

scripts/migration-lint.mjs enforcing M1 to M6: one schema per module, no cross-schema foreign key, the audit schema append-only, no P0 domain table, tenant_id on every tenant-owned table, and no unregistered migration directory
scripts/validate_continuity.py, fail-closed, validating badf/ and sessions/ against schemas/ and the cross-record rules
tests/boundaries with a fixture workspace and fixture migrations holding one deliberate violation per rule and one conforming case per rule
badf/ with five registries and three records; schemas/ with five JSON schemas
AGENTS.md, the charter carried from the guide repository and revised for a repository that ships software

validation.output_reference: BOUNDARY_GENERATION PASS 30 modules; no dependency violations found, 11 modules and 5 dependencies cruised
25 tests, 25 pass, 0 fail; 8 boundary controls and 7 migration controls each observed firing on its fixture, and 5 conforming imports reported by nothing
the validator fails closed on every malformed fixture

decisions: DEC-001 the repository is a skeleton whose contracts throw, because BT-G0 is unrecorded

assumptions: ASSUMED: the modular monolith of ARCH-001 section 4.1, with the seven dependency rules and one schema per module as the boundary and storage rules. ADR-001 decides this and is DRAFT_REQUIRED; if it narrows or widens the rules, the registry and the generator are revised and the suite re-run.

ASSUMED: the candidate modules of the ARCH-001 capability map are the registry entries, one package each. Whether each is a bounded context, a subdomain or an aggregate is BIZTRUST-DOMAIN-001's decision.
ASSUMED: dependency-cruiser as the checker, because its forbidden rules map one to one onto rules 1 to 7. The rules are generated, so a different checker consumes the same registry.
ASSUMED: the migration lint is a deterministic script under scripts/, per P0.2 open question 5. It is a text check over SQL, not a parser, and is conservative by design.
ASSUMED: GitHub as the host, with the branch protection the guide charter describes.
blockers: BT-G0 is unrecorded. ARCH-001 is a draft, and FOUNDATION_SEQUENCE.md slice S01 needs five human review seats that are unfilled. No P0 epic may be implemented until an architecture authority records it.
ADR-001, ADR-004, ADR-005, ADR-010 and ADR-011 are all DRAFT_REQUIRED. The rules in this repository are the proposal of a design at IN_REVIEW.
The repository administrator seat is unfilled, so main is unprotected and negative control 6 cannot be observed.
No verifier has reviewed this package. The P0.2 design names a verifier who is not the implementer, and WP-001 may not reach ACCEPTED without one.
authority_status: The scaffold was built under a direct operator instruction, recorded in badf/authority.yaml under granted.repository_scaffold. That is an operator instruction recorded by an agent; it is NOT the expiring implementation grant from a business authority seat that the P0.2 design requires, and it must not be read as one. Every other authority in that file is NOT_GRANTED.
